title: 🛂 Medical Visa Assistance & Travel Support
h1: Seamless Travel Arrangements for International Patients
intro: Traveling to India for treatment begins with the right visa and travel planning. We provide complete medical visa assistance, ensuring your journey is stress-free from the very first step.Our dedicated team helps with visa documentation, flight bookings, airport pickup, and safe transfers to your hospital or hotel — so you can focus only on your treatment.

sections.heading: 📋 Medical Visa Assistance
points: Help with visa application forms & guidelines
Invitation letter from partner hospitals
Support for Medical Attendant Visa (for family/companions)
Visa extensions if required for long-term treatment
Assistance with FRRO registration (for patients staying longer than 180 days)

sections.heading: ✈️ Travel Planning Support
points: Guidance on booking affordable international flights
Assistance with travel insurance & medical coverage
Airport pickup & drop facility with safe, sanitized vehicles
Help with domestic travel if treatment is outside Delhi/Gurugram

sections.heading: 🌍 Why Patients Trust Our Travel Services
points: 24/7 travel & visa support team
Experience in handling patients from 30+ countries
Hassle-free process with clear documentation
Multilingual assistance (Arabic, Russian, French & more)
Coordination with hospitals for smooth admission

sections.heading: 💰 Cost of Medical Visa & Travel Support
points: Visa Assistance: FREE (included in our patient support)
Flight Booking Support: At actual airline cost
Airport Pickup & Drop: $20 – $40 depending on city & distance

cta.headline: 📞 Plan Your Medical Journey with Ease
points: Quick visa processing
Airport pickup & transfers included
Complete end-to-end travel support
